title: Modern Treasury header
description: A white top bar with a soft drop shadow: green capitals wordmark on the left, a centred row of nav items (small chevrons flip on hover over a faint ink tint), and three square buttons on the right — two outlined, one solid ink. Sticks to the top from desktop up; phones get a menu button that opens a full-width panel.
notes: sticky only from lg up, like the original; on phones it scrolls away
the phone menu is a native <details> disclosure, so it works without JavaScript
